owner_calls.question: Earth designations for the Sony/Spider-Verse film universes: the dataset uses the plain numbers, Marvel Database uses B-suffixed pages for the film versions. Change? Affects in this batch: Earth-1610 (A:sv-peter-parker-1610, T:sv-green-goblin-itsv, T:sv-kingpin-itsv, T:sv-scorpion-itsv, T:sv-spot), Earth-8311 (A:sv-spider-ham), Earth-90214 (A:sv-spider-man-noir), Earth-688 (A:sv-anne-weying, A:sv-dan-lewis, A:sv-eddie-brock-sony, T:sv-venom-sony, A:sv-maria-venom, T:sv-carlton-drake, T:sv-riot, T:sv-treece, T:sv-xenophages).
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database's Earth-1610B page says it covers Earth-1610 'as depicted in the Spider-Verse films' (EarthNumber 1610, alias E-1610 on screen); Earth-688 there is a comics reality and the Sony Venom films are Earth-688B; film Spider-Ham and Noir are Peter Porker (Earth-8311B) and Peter Parker (Earth-90214B). The brief says to use Marvel Database designations, but the B is only its disambiguation suffix, so it is a convention question.
